title: Dedicated autoscaler: refined burst controls and improved utilization reporting
author: Priya Desai
commits: Refactor tokenbucket smoothing and burst window math (Priya Desai)
Add per-fleet utilization exporter and Prometheus metrics (Priya Desai)
Reduce autoscaler oscillation by adding hysteresis and min-evict-delay (Michael Chen)
Add unit + integration tests for burst scenarios (Sofia Martinez)
description:
Motivation: production Dedicated fleets observed spiky incoming load leading to oscillation in the autoscaler and inaccurate fleet utilization numbers used by SRE and cost reporting. This PR refines the burst control algorithm, adds smoothing/hysteresis, surfaces clearer utilization metrics per-fleet, and fixes edge cases in token-bucket accounting.

What this changes: 1) Autoscaler changes: - Introduced configurable burst_window and smoothing_factor for token-bucket based burst allowance. - Added min_evict_delay and scale_cooldown to reduce oscillation during transient bursts. - Improved queue-aware scaling: scale decisions now consider inflight-queue-length and effective throughput. 2) Reporting/observability: - New Prometheus metrics: redwood_dedicated_fleet_utilization_ratio, redwood_autoscaler_burst_tokens, redwood_autoscaler_decisions_total (labels: fleet_id,region). - Added daily aggregation job that emits 1h utilization summaries to the reporting topic for billing/ops dashboards. 3) Tests and safety: - Unit tests for burst math and hysteresis. - Integration test that replays historical burst scenario and asserts no more than 1 scale-up per 30s on average.

Checklist: - [x] Design doc reviewed (ENG-4821) - [x] Unit tests added - [x] Integration tests added - [x] Metrics validated in staging - [x] Feature flagged behind `autoscaler.v2_burst_controls`

Files changed (high level): - services/autoscaler/src/tokenbucket.rs: refactor burst window and smoothing math, new config parsing (small diff). - services/autoscaler/src/decision.rs: incorporate queue-aware heuristics and hysteresis. - services/metrics/exporter/fleet_utilization.rs: new exporter + Prometheus metrics. - infra/helm/redwood-dedicated/values.yaml: feature flag and default config knobs. - tests/integration/burst_scenarios.rs: scenario replay harness and assertions.

Example snippet (autoscaler config defaults): `burst_window: 60, smoothing_factor: 0.25, min_evict_delay: 45s, scale_cooldown: 30s`

CI: unit tests and integration tests run, linting and static checks pass. E2E canary validated on staging with zero errors for 48h.

Review conversation summary: - Alex: requested clearer doc on hysteresis math and proposed smaller default smoothing to avoid underutilization; added a comment asking for explicit tests around negative token drift. - Author (Priya): replied with rationale and added additional unit tests. - Michael: suggested adding min_evict_delay to avoid thrashing; author implemented and pushed change. - Sofia: requested metrics label cardinality checks; added metric relabeling in exporter. - Final: Approved after CI green and canary validation.

Merge: squash merge to main after staging canary. Release notes added below.
review_comments: Alex Kim: Please document hysteresis math and add a unit test for negative token drift.
Priya Desai: Added unit tests and expanded design note explaining tradeoffs.
Michael Chen: Recommend min_evict_delay to reduce immediate re-eviction during short bursts.
Sofia Martinez: Check label cardinality on new Prometheus metrics to avoid high cardinality.
Priya Desai: Added relabeling and default label whitelist for metrics.
release_notes: Dedicated autoscaler: tighter burst controls and improved per-fleet utilization reporting. Introduces configurable burst_window and smoothing_factor, hysteresis to reduce oscillation, and new Prometheus metrics for utilization and autoscaler decisions. Feature behind feature flag autoscaler.v2_burst_controls.
